news.title: Over 800 families get permanent titles after 120-year land dispute in Guntur district
news.para: In a significant development, a century-old land dispute in Guntur district has been settled. The state government has granted permanent land titles to 812 families from three villages, clarifying ownership over 41.46 acres of previously contested land. To enhance land records, authorities will introduce QR-coded passbooks following a thorough re-survey and digitisation process, aiming to address further land record challenges.

news.title: UrbanVault adds one lakh sq ft workspace in Chennai
news.para: UrbanVault has entered the Chennai market with workspace across three properties in Guindy and Velachery Main Road. The expansion comes as India’s flexible workspace operators recorded 26-44% year-on-year revenue growth in Q1 FY27, according to myHQ.

news.title: Visakhapatnam civic body's chief reviews town planning, TDR cases
news.para: Visakhapatnam Municipal Corporation reviewed town planning department performance and issued directives. Officials were instructed to expedite processing of all pending TDR cases promptly. Field monitoring will ensure buildings adhere strictly to approved construction plans. Encroachments on roads and footpaths must be identified and removed swiftly. Action will be taken against unauthorized constructions and waste dumping.

news.title: Belagavi civic body cracks down on tax evasion, begins property remeasurements
news.para: Belagavi City Corporation is embarking on an extensive remeasurement initiative for properties aimed at minimizing revenue loss and enhancing tax collection efficiency. Officials believe that numerous businesses are underreporting their actual built-up areas. Specialized teams are evaluating important industrial and commercial regions for mismatches, with a goal to update assessments and recover unpaid dues wherever applicable.

news.title: Aerocity to be developed near Indore airport, to attract ₹600 crore investment
news.para: The Madhya Pradesh government is set to launch an ambitious aerocity project adjacent to Indore airport, promising an investment ranging from Rs 500 to 600 crore. Situated just 500 metres from the airport, this innovative hub aims to enhance connectivity to the Indore-Pithampur Economic Corridor, while also featuring a theme-based amusement park close to Meghdoot Garden, creating a vibrant destination for both business and leisure.

news.title: ITAT rules tax officer cannot pin entire stamp-value gap on one co-owner
news.para: The Mumbai ITAT stated that one co-owner cannot be held accountable for the total tax discrepancy. The tribunal highlighted that the ownership shares had been explicitly recorded. The lack of action from tax authorities does not validate the taxation of just one owner’s share. Tax officers must conduct a proper review when disputing stamp-duty valuations. This ruling brings much-needed clarity to property buyers navigating valuation disputes.

news.title: Parmesh Construction Company buys 5.6 acre land parcel in Srinagar for ₹422 crore
news.para: An auction for the Sangarmaal City Centre in Srinagar brought in over Rs 421 crore, surpassing the government's expectations for the once-struggling commercial site. Parmesh Construction Company Ltd won the bidding war. In addition, the Batamaloo bus-stand land attracted an impressive bid of Rs 305 crore, with Construction Engineers landing the full-lease redevelopment project.

news.title: Delhi master plan 2047 proposes escrow account for transit oriented development projects
news.para: Delhi's Master Plan 2047 will use escrow accounts for development charges. This ensures funds are used for specific infrastructure like water and roads. Developers will pay levies directly into dedicated accounts for localized urban transformation. The plan also allows recreational activities on parts of the floodplain periphery. Discussions are ongoing to incorporate valuable suggestions into the master plan.

news.title: Construction of 16 stalled Supertech projects lagging, NCLAT seeks status report from NBCC
news.para: The NCLAT has called for a status report regarding the delayed projects of Supertech. Within a tight deadline of two weeks, both NBCC and the Apex Court Committee are expected to provide updates on their progress. Homebuyers have voiced their worries about the ongoing delays in the project timelines. NBCC was appointed to execute sixteen Supertech developments, yet construction has stalled for nearly twenty-one months.

news.title: Gurugram: DTCP directs DLF  to step up vigilance on vacant residential plots after misuse complaints
news.para: The DTCP has mandated DLF to oversee vacant residential plots in DLF 3 following numerous complaints regarding misuse. As the responsible entity for maintenance until the handover of the colonies, DLF is urged to aid in pinpointing and reporting such violations. This collaboration ensures adherence to land use regulations and planning standards.

news.title: Building plan approvals in Chandigarh go fully online
news.para: Chandigarh's administration proudly rolls out its online building plan approval system, addressing residential, commercial, and industrial property needs. With registered architects empowered to self-certify their blueprints, the processing timeframe is significantly shortened. The system keeps applicants informed with timely SMS and email alerts, and a user-friendly dashboard promotes efficient tracking and adherence to scheduled timelines.

news.title: Haryana RERA orders Identity Buildtech to pay 10.8% interest to UK couple for flat delay
news.para: A couple hailing from the UK has been left in the lurch after booking a flat nearly five years ago with Identity Buildtech Pvt Ltd in Sector 103. With no sign of construction progress and more than Rs 48 lakh already invested, the H-Rera mandated the developer to pay 10.8% annual interest for their tardiness. The developer's plea regarding the complaint's timeliness was firmly rejected by the authority.

news.title: West Bengal CM flags real estate fraud at consumer protection event
news.para: Suvendu Adhikari launched Consumer Rights Protection Week, addressing widespread fraud complaints.  The government is taking a zero-tolerance approach to all forms of consumer cheating.  Events will educate citizens about their rights and market inspections will occur.  Administrative actions have helped reduce recent price hikes for vegetables and sugar.  Authorities are cracking down on illegal practices and online scams affecting consumers.

news.title: NLMC to facilitate e-auction of 459 land parcels of Rashtriya Ispat Nigam in Visakhapatnam
news.para: The National Land Monetisation Corporation is set to auction 459 land parcels owned by Rashtriya Ispat Nigam Limited. The prime properties in Visakhapatnam cover over 93,000 square yards and come with clear government titles. Quikr India Pvt. Ltd. will oversee the transparent bidding process, scheduled for October 12 and October 16, 2026.

news.title: UK house prices rise in August despite economic headwinds: Nationwide
news.para: In August, British house prices rose slightly, defying economists' predictions amidst ongoing economic instability and geopolitical issues. This increase suggests improved affordability for prospective homeowners. Additionally, mortgage approvals are expected to rise modestly, though any future growth in house prices may be constrained by potential tax hikes in upcoming budgets.

news.title: Mortgage approvals in UK fall to lowest since January 2024: Bank of England data
news.para: British lenders approved the fewest mortgages for house purchase in July. Consumer lending grew more than expected, showing a significant monthly increase. Households may have funded spending by lowering savings and borrowing more. House prices rose below the rate of consumer price inflation. Monetary conditions are not conducive to a long period of high inflation.

news.title: Real estate firms strengthen leadership teams amid expansion and capital growth plans
news.para: WSB Real Estate Partners, Kolte-Patil Developers, K Raheja Group and CapitaLand Investment have announced senior leadership appointments in recent months. The appointments come as real estate firms focus on fundraising, execution, governance, portfolio growth and expansion across key asset classes.

news.title: Veegaland Developers IPO to open on September 10; price band fixed at ₹130-140
news.para: Veegaland Developers Ltd has revealed the price band for its upcoming initial public offering, set to raise Rs 210 crore. The IPO opens for public subscription on September 10, with anchor investor bidding on September 9. The funds from the IPO will be allocated for ongoing development projects and acquiring land for future expansion. The company, based in Kerala, is affiliated with the V-Guard Group.

news.title: Uttar Pradesh RERA mandates digital quarterly certificates from September 2026 quarter
news.para: Uttar Pradesh RERA has enabled digital submission of quarterly certificates by architects, engineers and chartered accountants through its web portal. The submission will be mandatory from the quarter ending September 30, 2026, and promoters will be able to upload QPRs only after these certificates are filed digitally.

news.title: Brigade to jointly develop 5.4 acres in Coimbatore; Kamdhenu Realities acquires 4-acre in Navi Mumbai
news.para: Brigade Enterprises is set to unveil a new residential venture in Coimbatore, stretching across 5.4 acres with a total gross development value (GDV) of approximately ₹600 crore. Meanwhile, Kamdhenu Realities has secured a four-acre land chunk in Thane, worth one hundred fifty crore rupees, aimed at creating a commercial park.
